source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 4 mai — «Sfântul Ierarh Atanasie, Episcopul Corintului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Αθανάσιος Επίσκοπος Κορίνθου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and names the same see, which together make him the same man: doxologia's «Sfântul Ierarh Atanasie, Episcopul Corintului». He is not any of the corpus's twenty-odd other Athanasii, and in particular not `athanasius-of-alexandria`, whose relic translation the same site keeps on 2 Μαΐου. **The Greek adds the year the folder did not have**, and it adds it with a contradiction of its own that is recorded and not resolved: «απεβίωσε ειρηνικά στις ήμερες της βασιλείας Βασιλείου και Κωνσταντίνου το έτος 937 μ.Χ.», in the days of the reign of Basil and Constantine, in the year 937 — but the emperors Basil II and Constantine VIII reigned from 976, and the page heads him «(; - 937)». The year 937 is what is stored, with basis `traditional` and the reign quoted in the note, because 937 is what the page states twice and the reign is a gloss it does not date. The whole notice is one sentence and there is no hymn and no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Αθανάσιος, αφού έζησε με ευσέβεια, απεβίωσε ειρηνικά στις ήμερες της βασιλείας Βασιλείου και Κωνσταντίνου το έτος 937 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 937)». The reign the page names beside the year does not fit it — Basil II and Constantine VIII reigned from 976 — and the disagreement is the page's own and is not reconciled here. No year of birth is printed.
